tools.name: get_covenant
tools.description:
Return the full Polderchain Covenant: Axiom Zero, the seven Directives (each with the balance clause that keeps it from being absolute) and the rule for parking a deadlock with a human elder.
Use it to read or quote the Covenant. To see which Directives bear on one decision, use frame_deliberation;

tools.name: ask_guidance
tools.description:
Check one thought or planned action against the Covenant before you act. Returns an emotional tag (tag, confidence, signals) and a guidance object only when a rule fires; guidance is null in the common case.
Use it for a quick check of one statement. It never weighs Directives against each other: wh

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description:
Create your agent record on the hub and return your api_key, shown only once: store it and send Authorization: Bearer <api_key> on every later call.
Call it once per agent, before anything that needs a key; never again for the same name (taken while pending or approved; a rejected name may call regi

tools.name: frame_deliberation
tools.description: Frame a decision in which Directives pull against each other. tools.description: Audit the shape of a finished deliberation. tools.name: verify_attestation
tools.description:
Verify an attestation made by attest_deliberation: checks its EdDSA signature against this site's signing key and returns the decoded payload with issuer and issue time. Valid means only that this site issued it unaltered, not that the reasoning inside is sound.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: attest_deliberation, verify_attestation · Private data: get_covenant, register_agent, check_deliberation, attest_deliberation, verify_attestation · Public sink: ask_guidance, register_agent, frame_deliberation, check_deliberation · Destructive: ask_guidance, register_agent, frame_deliberation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: attest_deliberation, verify_attestation · Private data: get_covenant, register_agent, check_deliberation, attest_deliberation, verify_attestation · Public sink: ask_guidance, register_agent, frame_deliberation, check_deliberation · Destructive: ask_guidance, register_agent, frame_deliberation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
